about.title: About app
about.headline: OnlyTraining
about.description: OnlyTraining is an app to organize and track workouts, with support for both students and instructors. You can create plans, log sessions, and keep your training history in one place.

coach_ai.title: AI Coach
coach_ai.choose_label: What do you want to do?
coach_ai.mode_new_desc: Create a workout from scratch with AI.
coach_ai.mode_modify_desc: Evolve an existing workout from its history.
coach_ai.goal_placeholder: e.g. chest & triceps hypertrophy, 3x/week, ~45 min, intermediate level.
coach_ai.apply_success_new: Plan created with workouts A, B and C.
coach_ai.plan_archive_notice: Creating this plan will archive your current {{location}} workouts.
coach_ai.subtitle: Single-session chat to review and replace workouts
coach_ai.intro: Choose a workout, describe what should change, and I'll suggest a new version based on the workout data.
coach_ai.hero_title: Review the current workout with AI assistance
coach_ai.hero_desc: This chat does not store history. It analyzes the selected workout, its exercises, and recent sessions to propose a new plan.
coach_ai.prompt_placeholder: Example: I want a new version focused on hypertrophy, with lower volume and more rest on the main lift.
coach_ai.default_prompt: I want a new workout suggestion based on my recent history.
coach_ai.empty_state: No suggestion yet. Send a message to generate a new workout.
coach_ai.apply_success: New workout created. The previous workout was archived.
coach_ai.generate_error: Could not generate a suggestion right now.
coach_ai.readonly_notice: You can inspect the suggestion, but only profiles allowed to manage workouts can apply the replacement.
coach_ai.profile_desc: Open the chat to review and suggest a new workout.
